messages.content: Explain in exactly three sentences why floating-point addition is not associative.
Explain in exactly three sentences why floating-point addition is not associative.

samples.text: Floating-point numbers have limited precision, which causes rounding errors when representing real numbers. When adding three numbers, the order of operations determines which intermediate sums are rounded first. These different rounding points can lead to different final results, thus violating the associative property (a + b) + c = a + (b + c).
